translationRepairs: His elder brother's son Shao was a leader of the palace tiger guard, by nature careless, simple, and extravagant.
His elder brother's son Shao was a leader of the palace tiger guard, by nature careless and lax, and extravagant.
In s0009 性疏簡奢侈, 疏簡 is the compound 'careless/lax'; 'simple' misreads 簡 as bare simplicity rather than negligence paired with 疏.
I have been blessed to live in a glorious age and to receive the civil and martial teaching of the sages—how could I cling to office, evade blame, and withhold my utmost loyalty!
I have been blessed to live in a glorious age and to meet the civilizing influence of Wen and Wu—how could I cling to office, evade blame, and withhold my utmost loyalty!
s0234 逢文武之化 names Wen and Wu; rendering them as anonymous 'sages' and 'civil and martial teaching' erases those person references.
Thereupon Shao further observed restraint, and great and small none dared violate him.
Thereupon Shao further observed restraint, and none great or small dared commit violations.
After 紹更遵節, 大小莫敢違犯 means none dared violate the standards of conduct, not that none dared violate Shao personally.

Li Ying and his fellows have shown loyal resolve and devotion to the house of Han—they are truly ministers in the mold of Ji, Xie, Yi, and Lü—yet wicked men have falsely accused them; the realm is heartsick and the empire has lost hope.

Li Ying and his fellows have shown loyal resolve and devotion to the royal house—they are truly ministers in the mold of Ji, Xie, Yi, and Lü—yet wicked men have falsely accused them; the realm is heartsick and the empire has lost hope.
s0241 志經王室 is devotion to the royal house; 'house of Han' invents a polity name absent from the Chinese.

It happened that in the fifth month there was a solar eclipse; Fan again persuaded Wu, saying: "In the past Xiao Wangzhi was trapped by a single Shi Xian; in recent times the misfortune of the various gentlemen Li and Du reached their wives and children; how much more now are there several tens of generations of Shi Xian!

It happened that in the fifth month there was a solar eclipse; Fan again persuaded Wu, saying: "In the past Xiao Wangzhi was trapped by a single Shi Xian; in recent times the misfortune of the various gentlemen Li and Du reached their wives and children; how much more now are there several tens of fellows of the Shi Xian sort!
石顯數十輩 means dozens of fellows of the Shi Xian type; 'generations of Shi Xian' wrongly takes 輩 as generational descent.
Cao Jie heard the alarm, roused the boy emperor, and said, "Trouble is brewing outside; come with us to the front hall of Deyang Palace."
Cao Jie heard it, started up in alarm, and reported to the emperor, saying, "Trouble is brewing outside; I ask that you go out to the front hall of Deyang Palace."
曹節聞之，驚起，白帝曰 makes 驚起 Cao Jie's own startled rising and 白帝 a report to the emperor, not rousing him; the Chinese has only 帝, not 'boy emperor'.

A forged edict named Zhou Jing of the lesser treasury acting chariot-and-cavalry general, gave him the baton of command, and ordered him and the Xiongnu colonel Zhang Huan to lead the five camps against Dou Wu.

An edict named Zhou Jing of the lesser treasury acting chariot-and-cavalry general, gave him the baton of command, and ordered him and the Xiongnu colonel Zhang Huan to lead the five camps against Dou Wu.
s0071 opens with bare 詔; 'forged' is not in this sentence and must not be imported from surrounding interpretation.

Jin secretly knew their plot; then he memorialized to dispatch Yuan Shao east to attack the troops of the two provinces Xu and Yan; he waited for Shao to return, then military affairs, in order to delay the date of departure.

Jin secretly knew their plot; then he memorialized to dispatch Yuan Shao east to attack the troops of the two provinces Xu and Yan; only when Shao returned would he take up the western campaign, in order to delay the date of departure.
須紹還，即戎事 means only then would he take up the campaign; the original's dangling 'then military affairs' is ungrammatical and opaque.
When the affair was discovered, Jie and others urgently arrested him.
When the affair was discovered, Jie and others hunted him urgently.
捕之急 marks urgent pursuit of Fu; s0085 shows he was still being smuggled away, so completed 'arrested' overstates the Chinese.
They also said: "The grand general specializedly kills those at his side and monopolizes power to weaken the altars of soil and grain."
They also said: "The grand general kills those at his side at will and monopolizes power to weaken the altars of soil and grain."
專殺左右 means killing those at his side at will / monopolizing killing; 'specializedly' is not English and misrenders 專.
Shuo had received the testamentary edict, and always lightly envied Jin and his brothers; when the emperor died, Shuo was inside and wished first to execute Jin and then establish Xie.

Shuo had received the testamentary edict, and had always lightly regarded and been jealous of Jin and his brothers; when the emperor died, Shuo was inside and wished first to execute Jin and then establish Xie.
素輕忌於進兄弟 combines long-standing contempt (輕) with jealousy/wariness (忌); 'lightly envied' collapses both into mere envy.
staff supervisor Wang Yun was governor of Henan.
staff supervisor Wang Yun was made governor of Henan.
Continuing s0175's appointments, 從事中郎王允為河南尹 uses 為 for making Wang Yun governor, not a bare stative 'was'.
They had served many reigns; leaving the palace grieved them. They begged one last turn of duty to look upon the empress dowager and His Majesty, then they would crawl into their graves content."

I have enjoyed imperial favor for generations, and now that I must leave the palace, I cannot bear to go. I ask to serve one final watch and look once more upon the empress dowager and Your Majesty. Then I can withdraw to die in obscurity, without regret."
Zhang Rang's first-person plea 惟受恩累世…願復一入直 must stay singular; plural 'They' invents collective speakers absent from the Chinese.
Zhang Rang and Duan Gui forged edicts naming Fan Ling, the former grand commandant, metropolitan commandant and Xu Xiang of the lesser treasury governor of Henan.
Zhang Rang and Duan Gui forged edicts naming Fan Ling, the former grand commandant, metropolitan commandant, and Xu Xiang, of the lesser treasury, governor of Henan.
少府許相為河南尹 names Xu Xiang of the lesser treasury as appointee to Henan; 'lesser treasury governor of Henan' fuses prior office and new post into one broken phrase.
Some who had no whiskers died by mistake; those who reached exposing themselves by shaving then obtained release were more than two thousand.
Some who had no whiskers died by mistake; those who reached the point of exposing themselves and only then obtained release were more than two thousand.
至自發露然後得免 means exposing the body to prove one is not a eunuch; 'by shaving' invents an action not in the Chinese.
